subject: Two remaining memory-safety preflight checks in common texture/render helpers
body:
Seven prior texture fixes are confirmed at source level, but current nord2_texture_resources.h still dereferences l before validation in BOTH n2t_pack_layout line881 AND n2t_plane_pack line1087 (view_metal initializer). Move read after null/layout validation; exercise public sampled/storage/plane NULL calls with valid output and unchanged output sentinel.
New render issue: n2r_validate_impl calls n2r_texture_resources_check before gd_request_ok. The preflight loops y<q->binding_count at nord2_metal_render.c45 without first enforcing q->binding_count<=TEGU_GENERIC_DRAW_MAX_BINDINGS. An oversized request with a sidecar whose binding is absent can read beyond the embedded array before the later generic validator rejects it. Validate request count before that loop. Add real n2r_validate_v2 and n2r_build_v2 malformed-count tests under ASan/UBSan; a source-only assertion is insufficient. Structural freeze remains conditional on these negative tests. No production edits/build by audit.
